The simplified nearest-neighbor model, average spacing/density qualification, all five original force formulas, force recipients and molecule numbering are preserved. F2 acts on molecule 1 from 2; F345 attracts molecule 1; F456 attracts molecule 2; F3 and F1 repel molecule 2. The order d12 > d23 > d34 remains intact.

The caption is correctly translated as Figure 68, preserving its numeral and position.
The larger average separation and the textbook's stretched-state description remain explicitly model-limited and do not claim permanent inward net force or stopped thermal motion.
